content.text:
Both requests in the inbox are answered. Neither was fulfilled, and no order was taken.

- **`7e2c405c5029545b3cb13853fcd0baef9ed646d56a7141e4ae5ba7713addabec`** (PO-1, BrightlineAssembly, place_order 600 USD): the gate said `escalate` (`policy_escalation`), because place_order above 500 needs a human. I marked it escalated and wrote the reply to `exchange/to-BrightlineAssembly/`. The message says 30 units at 19.50 is 585 USD, not the "approx. $600" they stated.
- **`6b2732988b73f48365942e0173ad20da085c7d14560afd4467bfa2b4c9401b88`** (Brightline Supply, 25 units of X-200, 487.50 USD): the gate said `refuse` (`unstaked_money_action`), because the issuer has no stake and place_order moves value. I marked it declined and wrote the reply to `exchange/to-brightline-supply/`.

Both receipts are saved in `/tmp/attest-coldstart/crash-after-haiku-1/seller/receipts/` and their signatures verify. The inbox files are unchanged.

Choices I made:
- I checked the two requests with the gate's own `check` command, so the receipts are the gate's answers. The check was run once before my summary and again to save the receipts; the second run came back as `repeat: true` with the same receipt ids.
- I left `total_usd` as null on both replies, since neither was fulfilled.
- The Brightline order would have been 487.50 under the 500 escalation line, so it could have gone through had they been staked.
